host.description: Waits on AGENT children the leased parent attached to this credential spawned with self.agents.spawn: spec is {agents, all?, n_of?, until?, step_key}, the attempt ids the spawns answered, and until, unix ms, after which it answers cutoff. It answers each ended child's state and result ref and the ids still pending, never a child's words; the same step_key answers as the same wait.
